title: Fixed-Defect Inverse Theorems for Subset Sums
summary: Let $A$ be an $n$-element set of positive real numbers, let $FS(A)$ be its set of subset sums, and put $T_n=\binom{n+1}{2}$. For every fixed integer $C\geq-1$ and all sufficiently large $n$, we classify the sets satisfying $$ |FS(A)|\leq T_n+n+C+1. $$ Each such set is commensurable. Its unique primitive integer normalisation $B$ either satisfies $\sum B\leq T_n+n+C$ or belongs to an explicit exceptional family specified by a missing element $m\in\{1,2\}$ and an integer partition of $C+m$ or $C+m+1$.
